_comment_overview: This file demonstrates the structure of a damage calculation pipeline.
_comment_how_it_works: The pipeline processes damage through sequential 'buckets', each applying transformations to the damage context.
_comment_customization: To customize: modify bucket order, add/remove operations, or create new buckets with filters.

buckets._comment: BUCKET 1: BASE - Establishes initial damage value
buckets._description: Sums base damage from the action plus any flat added damage modifiers

operations._comment: Add base damage from action definition
Add any flat damage bonuses (from equipment, buffs, etc.)

buckets._comment: BUCKET 2: INCREASED - Applies additive percentage bonuses
buckets._description: Applies 'increased damage' modifiers (additive). Example: 50% + 30% = 80% total increase

operations._comment: Apply all 'increased damage' bonuses as a single additive multiplier
operations._example: If increased_damage_total = 0.8, damage becomes: damage * (1 + 0.8) = damage * 1.8

buckets._description: Applies 'more damage' multipliers (multiplicative). Each multiplier is applied separately.
buckets._note: Currently uses 3 fixed slots. This will be replaced with dynamic list in future versions.

buckets._comment: BUCKET 4: CRITICAL - Multi-tier critical hit system
buckets._description: Rolls for critical hit and applies damage multiplier based on tier achieved
buckets._execution: Only runs if action has 'can_crit' tag
buckets._system: Tier 0 = normal hit, Tier 1+ = critical hit with increasing multipliers
buckets._formula: Uses CRIT_GUARANTEED_TIER, CRIT_EXTRA_CHANCE, and CRIT_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER formulas

filterConditions._comment: Only process critical hits for actions that can crit

operations._comment: Roll for critical tier and apply damage multiplier
operations._mechanics: Guaranteed tier = floor(crit_chance / 100), then roll for +1 tier based on remainder
operations._example: 150% crit chance = guaranteed Tier 1, 50% chance for Tier 2

buckets._comment: BUCKET 5: MITIGATION - Applies target's damage reduction
buckets._description: Reduces damage based on target's armor value

operations._parameters_explained: ARMOR = target's armor stat, DAMAGE = current damage value

_operation_ADD_FLAT: Adds a flat value to current damage. Source: 'modifier:key', 'constant:123.45', or '123.45'
_operation_MULTIPLY: Multiplies current damage by a value. Source: same as ADD_FLAT
_operation_APPLY_FORMULA: Applies a MathEngine formula. Source: 'formula:FORMULA_NAME', parameters map to formula inputs
_operation_SET_TAG: Adds a tag to the damage context. Source: tag name (with or without 'tag:' prefix)
_operation_REMOVE_TAG: Removes a tag from the damage context. Source: tag name
_operation_SET_MODIFIER: Sets a modifier value. Source: value, parameters.key = modifier name
_operation_ADD_TO_MODIFIER: Adds to existing modifier. Source: value to add, parameters.key = modifier name
_operation_ROLL_CRIT_TIER: Special operation for multi-tier critical system. No source needed.
_filter_TAG_PRESENT: Bucket runs only if specified tag exists. parameter = tag name
_filter_TAG_ABSENT: Bucket runs only if specified tag is missing. parameter = tag name
_filter_MODIFIER_PRESENT: Bucket runs only if modifier exists. parameter = modifier key
_filter_MODIFIER_ABOVE: Bucket runs only if modifier > threshold. parameter = key, value = threshold
_filter_MODIFIER_BELOW: Bucket runs only if modifier < threshold. parameter = key, value = threshold
_example_1: To add elemental damage: Create new bucket with TAG_PRESENT filter for 'fire', apply fire-specific multipliers
_example_2: To add resistance: Create bucket after mitigation with MODIFIER_PRESENT filter for 'fire_resistance'
_example_3: To change calculation order: Modify 'order' values (critical before more, mitigation before increased, etc.)
_example_4: To add conditional damage: Use MODIFIER_ABOVE/BELOW filters (e.g., bonus damage when target health < 30%)
_tip_1: Set emitEvents: true to track each bucket's input/output damage via BucketProcessedEvent
_tip_2: Check logs for 'Pipeline start' and 'Pipeline end' messages with damage deltas
_tip_3: Use DamageCalculatedEvent to see final damage, crit tier, and full metadata
_tip_4: Validate JSON structure with PipelineConfiguration.Validate() - checks for duplicate IDs and order gaps
_ref_formulas: Available formulas defined in MathEngine (LINEAR_ADDITIVE, ARMOR_REDUCTION, CRIT_* formulas)
_ref_alternative: See DamagePipeline.high-crit.json for alternative configuration example
